purpose: Fixed forest decision-policy calibration, then one untouched final pair; no training or automatic deployment

trials.activity: Scroll feed for 30 seconds, then watch different Reels for 30 seconds.
Open a different YouTube video and watch for 60 seconds.
On a later date after policy freeze, watch a different video for 60 seconds.
On that same final date, scroll feed for 30 seconds and watch different Reels for 30 seconds.

eligibility: mapped-valid-prefix-v1; all supported mapped flows retained; ambiguous/unmapped inventory preserved; no prediction-based exclusion
primary: Accepted error/coverage per class and overall on available10/20/30 prefixes, with separate10-packet class support. Correlated points, no population guarantee.
diagnostic_pass: Same frozen empirical error/coverage/support constraints at calibration and final; public control only at calibration. No threshold changes after final.
collection: Normal Chrome and Edge app visible; Wi-Fi; reference checkbox on; longer-window statistics off; Strip private information NetLog, sensitive/raw bytes off; cap 120 seconds. User starts both logs before fresh target navigation.
attempts: Exactly two calibration visits. If no threshold passes, stop: no final visits, extra recordings, threshold/gate relaxation or model retuning. If feasible, freeze policy bundle before two later-date final visits. One attempt per slot; unusable attempt stops workflow.
scoring: Calibration may read only its two new archives and historical public calibration split. No prior local study, old calibration or public final-test rows. Final only after policy freeze and both final archives, no fitting or threshold changes.
limits: Decision-policy calibration is empirical threshold selection, not a probability-of-correctness guarantee. Local evidence covers two services; retrospective public control is not forward local validation. Completed comparison remains sealed. No automatic model activation.

policy_rules.thresholds: 0.00..1.00 step0.01; choose lowest eligible threshold, maximum monotone coverage
